notes_for_editor: Thin record. The tnlandforms index (row GA121) is the only source that calls this site a lookout tower. The MyTopo summit list confirms a Mullinax Mountain exists in Bartow County but says nothing about a tower. Searches (two WebSearch calls) found no tower history, and the NHLR Georgia index in the local cache does not list it. The index gives an elevation of 1066 but the story leaves it out because the index does not state a unit. Check with the Georgia Forestry Commission or a Bartow County GIS source before publishing any status. Story is short by necessity.
